text:
cheng: perf-bot alerted a p99 token-latency regression on ql-small after today's split-batcher rollout. seeing a sharp tail increase on gen-heavy traces. https://perf.internal/treemap/2867

perf-bot: auto-alert: p99 +18% vs baseline, regression window 2026-03-17T09:12Z. sample ids: [s-984, s-991, s-1002].

anya: i pulled a few request traces. looks like kernel queue wait time spikes when batch_size==1 and kv-miss rate climbs. grabbing flamegraphs now.

leo: quick note: the kernel-selector change in PR #5432 now prefers int8_affine kernel for generation-stage. that kernel has a slightly longer enqueue path for microbatches, which may be interacting badly with our single-queue scheduling. also noticed kv-priming-window was reduced from 12ms -> 4ms in that commit.

maria: can you paste the profiler snippet? small sample is enough.

cheng: here's a short perf sample from staging (nvprof-like):

```
# trace s-991
enqueue_wait_ms: 6.8
kernel_exec_ms (int8_affine): 1.9
kv_lookup_ms (miss): 4.3
total_token_ms: 13.5
p99_tail: 48ms -> 57ms
```

anya: hypothesis: coupling init-stage (prefill) and gen-stage onto the same queue reduced prefill priority and shrank KV priming. result = more kv-misses during generation -> decode paths pay cache refill penalty.

leo: proposed quick experiment in staging: (1) split init vs gen onto two queues (silo prefill), (2) bump kv-priming-window to 16ms, (3) add kernel-affinity hint to prefer fp16 for microbatch=1, (4) adjust token_budget_target to 8 tokens for small models.

cheng: ran the experiment for 30m on staging traffic: p99 improved ~10% vs the regressed baseline, p50 unchanged. kv-miss rate dropped from 14% -> 5% on sampled requests.

maria: opening PR #5471 to add per-model phase queues + kernel-affinity hints. short config diff:

```
model_runtime:
  queues:
    init_stage: {priority: high, max_batch_ms: 12}
    gen_stage:  {priority: normal, max_batch_ms: 8}
  kv_priming_window_ms: 16
  kernel_hints: ["prefer_fp16_for_microbatch_1"]
  token_budget_target: 8
```

anya: plan: canary the config to 5% of traffic, watch p99 and kv-miss metric. if stable for 1h, rollout. also we should revert the kernel-selector preference if affinity hint doesn't hold.

perf-bot: scheduled canary rollout for PR #5471 to cluster-staging at 2026-03-17T10:05Z. monitoring: p99_token_latency, kv_miss_rate, kernel_queue_wait_ms.

leo: thanks team. i'll follow up with a short bench to see if the int8_affine enqueue path can be optimized (it's cheap on throughput but expensive on microbatch enqueue).

cheng: :thumbsup: small wins but important. will add a regression test in the perf harness to catch future kv-priming-window regressions.

maria: bumping this in the 2pm eng-runtime sync.

leo: ack :eyes:
